notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After several patches and improvements to Retaliation Path of Kingdoms, we have finally released the Free Demo on Steam.
In the Demo you will have 4 weeks of gameplay to try out all the features.

The best advice we can give you is to try the game with the demo before you buy it!

notes.title: Path notes 1.0227
notes.content:
In this patch, we corrected some bugs and improved some aspects of the game interface:

[list]
[*] Updated texts in tutorials
[*] Added the tutorial for displaying the game map
[*] Improved the in-game generation of some maps
[*] Corrections of some small bugs. 
[/list]
